feature: Reconcile stale Picco integration documentation with current implementation

inspected_contracts.progress UI and routing: main.rs loads Service, dispatches start/cancel/conflict/reset, chooses LAN or captured tailnet driver, and polls journal commits.
inspected_contracts.sleep barriers: panel.rs stops tailnet, catalog and progress in order with separate five-second waits before panel and Wi-Fi shutdown.
inspected_contracts.home relay: tailnet.rs invokes relay_pool::next_plan; the pool requests a missing eligible home independently of queued peer traffic.
inspected_contracts.startup: main.rs polls ReaderStartup::step between loading-frame updates and input checks.
inspected_contracts.snapshot preparation: Session::prepare takes an immutable Reader reference; worker-side exchange performs source validation.

limits: The host tests compile actual progress service and commit modules with injected transport, not the ESP-IDF main loop or physical networking.
Sleep ordering, startup and home-relay documentation changes use source inspection; no new execution qualification for those paths.
No firmware rebuild or independent network rerun in this documentation-only checkpoint.
